name: Models3D Studio – 3D Product Viewer & Configurator for WooCommerce
author: Alkcode

sections.description:
Models3D Studio brings high-fidelity interactive 3D product viewer and configurator capabilities, real-time variation mapping, and PBR material inspection directly into the WooCommerce store workflow.

Allow your customers to rotate, zoom, inspect, and configure products in photorealistic 3D before buying. Models3D Studio seamlessly connects WooCommerce variation attributes (colors, materials, finishes, and components) to 3D meshes in your GLB models, updating visuals instantly in the browser without server lag.

Live Demo (Pro Edition)

Explore our live interactive 3D product configurators and Visual Studio sandboxes (showcases the Pro edition with all features unlocked — click “Free vs Pro” in the top header to compare Free and Pro features):

  • Forged Performance Wheel (Automotive): Storefront Product Page | 3D Visual Studio Sandbox
  • Sovereign Gemstone Solitaire Ring (Jewelry): Storefront Product Page | 3D Visual Studio Sandbox
  • Royal Victorian Coffee Table (Furniture): Storefront Product Page | 3D Visual Studio Sandbox
  • Quad-Cam V16 Motorsport Crate Engine (Motorsport): Storefront Product Page | 3D Visual Studio Sandbox
  • VortexSeries GT-8 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard (Electronics): Storefront Product Page | 3D Visual Studio Sandbox
  • Athletic Sneaker Showcase (Footwear): Storefront Product Page | 3D Visual Studio Sandbox

Key Features

  • Photorealistic 3D Canvas: Real-time WebGL rendering powered by Three.js and React Three Fiber with full PBR (Physically Based Rendering) material support.
  • 3D Poster & Click-to-Load Mode: Show your Featured Image (or a custom poster image) instantly and choose whether the 3D model loads automatically behind it or only when the shopper clicks “View in 3D”, protecting page speed (LCP).
  • Built-In Client-Side GLB Optimizer (Free): Models over 3MB are optimized in your browser before upload: embedded PNG/JPG textures are converted to WebP, and geometry is compressed with a locally bundled Google Draco WASM encoder (no external CDN).
  • 1-Click Sample 3D Product: Test the full 3D viewer and Visual Studio workflow right after installation with the one-click sample product generator.
  • Bi-Directional WooCommerce Variation Sync: Instantly connects WooCommerce attribute swatches and select dropdowns to 3D meshes, textures, and material finishes.
  • Interactive 3D Visual Studio v2: Dedicated full-screen admin editor with a 5-Workspace Left Rail (Variations, Scene, Hotspots, Features, Asset), Quick-Jump Search (Ctrl+K), 1-click “Capture Current View as Default & 2D Poster”, and a 5-Tab Variation Inspector (Look, Visibility, Transform, Model, Motion).
  • Multi-Channel Variation Customization: Independent controls for PBR material properties (roughness, metalness, colors, 6 quick presets) in the Free edition, plus per-variation part visibility overrides (Hide / Show mesh layers), per-variation texture map swapping (.webp/.jpg + UV tiling), per-variation part transforms (scale/position/rotation), per-variation .glb model overrides, and per-variation keyframe animations in the Pro edition.
  • Camera Orbit Limits & Shareable Configurations (Free & Pro): Lock vertical tilt (Horizon Lock — Above Floor Only or Horizontal Turntable Only), control close-up/interior zoom and panning, and let shoppers copy a deep-linked URL to their exact selected 3D variation.
  • Gutenberg Block, Shortcode, Archive Badges & Modal Mode: Embed 3D models anywhere via the Models3D 3D Viewer & AR Gutenberg block (models3d/viewer) or [models3d_viewer] shortcode, display lightweight "3D & AR" badges on Shop/Category archives, or launch the viewer in a full-screen modal lightbox.
  • WCAG 2.2 & EAA Accessibility (Free & Pro): Built-in keyboard camera navigation (Arrow keys to orbit, +/- to zoom, Space to pause/spin, R to reset), prefers-reduced-motion: reduce auto-pause, and aria-live screen-reader announcements.
  • Native 2D Fallback Protection: Graceful degradation to standard WooCommerce product images if WebGL is unavailable or when JavaScript is disabled.
  • Zero External Rendering Fees: 100% self-hosted client-side execution. No SaaS subscription or third-party cloud rendering required.
  • Universal Builder & Theme Compatibility: Works smoothly with standard WooCommerce themes, Block themes (FSE), and major page builders.

External services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

  1. Freemius API (https://api.freemius.com)

* Service Used: Freemius SDK (https://freemius.com)
* Purpose: Optional user opt-in telemetry, account synchronization, and software license verification.
* Data Sent: Site URL, active theme name, WordPress and PHP versions, and administrator email (transmitted strictly upon explicit user opt-in or during license activation).
* Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/
* Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

  1. Drei HDRI Environment Repository (https://raw.githack.com/pmndrs/drei-assets/)

* Service Used: pmndrs/drei-assets via raw.githack.com (GitHub CDN)
* Purpose: Provides high dynamic range (HDR) radiance environment lighting maps for realistic 3D PBR material reflections when the user selects a preset studio or outdoor environment in the 3D Visual Studio editor.
* Data Sent: None. Only public read-only static .hdr radiance map assets are downloaded via HTTPS GET when a preset is chosen.
* Terms of Service: https://raw.githack.com/
* Privacy Policy: https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/models3d-studio-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce -> 3D Studio to configure global viewer display preferences.
  4. Edit any WooCommerce product, open the 3D Studio tab in the Product Data box, and upload your .glb model.
  5. Launch the 3D Visual Studio to map your WooCommerce attributes to 3D meshes and materials.
sections.faq:
Does this require an external rendering service or monthly subscription?

No. All 3D rendering happens locally inside the customer’s web browser using standard WebGL via Three.js. There are zero external rendering charges or ongoing cloud service requirements for the core viewer.

Which 3D file formats are supported?

Models3D Studio supports standard .glb and .gltf binary formats, including Google Draco compression and KHR material extensions. Models over 3MB are optimized in your browser (WebP texture conversion and Draco geometry compression) before upload.

Will 3D models slow down my WooCommerce product page?

You control how the model loads. In the 3D loading settings you can show your Featured Image (or a custom poster image) first and load the 3D model only when the shopper clicks “View in 3D”, so the page paints a normal image before any 3D data is downloaded.

How do variable products work with 3D models?

You upload a multi-part or multi-variant GLB file (or assign separate .glb files to specific variations in Pro). In the 3D Visual Studio, you connect each WooCommerce attribute (e.g. Color, Finish, Component, Size) to specific mesh parts, materials, or variation .glb models. When customers pick variations on the product page, the 3D model automatically updates in real time.

What happens if a customer visits with an older browser or device without WebGL?

Models3D Studio includes an automated fail-safe fallback system. If WebGL is unsupported or encounters an error, the plugin automatically restores the standard 2D WooCommerce product gallery image.

Where can I find documentation and tutorials?

Full offline documentation is bundled inside the plugin under WooCommerce -> 3D Studio -> Documentation. You can also visit our online portal at https://models3dstudio.com/
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Enhancement: Redesigned the 3D Visual Studio v2 with a 5-Workspace Left Rail (Variations, Scene, Hotspots, Features, Asset), Quick-Jump Setting Search (Ctrl+K), 5-Tab Variation Inspector (Look, Visibility, Transform, Model, Motion), live variation pill color dots, and bundled Outfit + Inter typography.
  • Enhancement: Added 1-click “Capture Current View as Default & 2D Poster” in the 3D Visual Studio with automatic WooCommerce Product Image sync and custom background compositing.
  • Enhancement: Added Camera Orbit Limits (Free 360°, Horizon Lock — Above Floor Only, Horizontal Turntable Only), Allow Close-Up / Interior Zoom, and Lock Panning (Keep Model Centered) controls.
  • Enhancement: Added native Gutenberg Block (models3d/viewer — “Models3D 3D Viewer & AR”), standalone [models3d_viewer src="..." height="..." preset="..."] attributes, Shop/Category Archive "3D & AR" badges, 3D Modal / Lightbox placement mode, Shareable Configuration Links (🔗 Share), and GA4 / dataLayer analytics events.
  • Enhancement: Added WCAG 2.2 & European Accessibility Act (EAA) compliance with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce auto-pause, keyboard arrow orbit/zoom controls, and aria-live announcements.
  • Enhancement (Pro): Added Mobile Augmented Reality (“View in Your Space”) with variation-aware iOS ARKit Quick Look (.USDZ), Android Live Camera AR & Scene Viewer (.GLB), floor/wall placement, and a zero-dependency local SVG QR Code modal (?m3ds_ar=1 deep linking).
  • Enhancement (Pro): Added 3D Dimensions Bounding-Box Ruler (W × H × D in cm/mm/m/in), Procedural 💥 Exploded View HUD Slider (0%–100% with zero Blender animation required), and 1-Page Printable PDF Spec Sheet download.
  • Enhancement (Pro): Added Per-Variation Texture Map Swapping (.webp/.jpg Wood, Fabric, Leather + UV Repeat X/Y tiling), Per-Variation Part Scale/Position/Rotation Offsets (Transform), Per-Variation .GLB 3D Model Overrides, Virtual Photographer (📸 Capture All Thumbnails), and 1-click Copy/Paste Studio Config JSON across products.
  • Enhancement (Pro): Added Interactive 3D Hotspots & Feature Callouts (info_card, camera_focus, variation_select, model_swap, animation_play, external_link), Embedded .GLB Keyframe Animation Playback (repeat, once, pingpong), Live 3D Variation Snapshots in Cart/Checkout/HPOS Orders, and 3D Asset Theft Protection (Signed & Byte-Scrambled Delivery).

1.1.24

  • Enhancement: Added 1-click “Create Sample 3D Product (Draft)” generator and “Activate WooCommerce Instantly” onboarding on plugins.php and WooCommerce -> 3D Studio.
  • Fix: Fixed “Sync Layers to All” in the 3D Visual Studio to expand synced mesh categories and unlock sibling material controls.
  • Documentation: Clarified Free vs. Pro edition capabilities and added a WordPress Playground blueprint.

1.1.0

  • Initial WordPress.org repository release. (See CHANGELOG.md for full version history).
